name: Levetiracetam
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 500 mg twice daily; increase by 500 mg twice daily every 2 weeks to 1,500 mg twice daily

usual_adult_dose.indication: Myoclonic and primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures (adults)
usual_adult_dose.dose: Same titration to 1,500 mg twice daily

common: Children: fatigue, aggression, nasal congestion, decreased appetite, irritability
serious: Behavioral abnormalities, psychotic symptoms, suicidal ideation
Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis, DRESS

pk.half_life_eskd: Prolonged; total clearance 70% lower in anuric ESRD (label)
pk.metabolism: Enzymatic hydrolysis (not CYP) to inactive ucb L057
